claims.evidence: No VIN tag, casting number, or vehicle-fitment label visible in any photo; witness could not read any identifying marks.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium (also says 'Direct America drive')
claims.evidence: No import documents, shipping tags, or port markings visible; the seller's own text is internally inconsistent (Belgium vs America), which the photos cannot resolve.
No start-up video, compression test, or running clip in the report; photos show a static, disconnected unit on the ground.
No odometer, ECU printout, or service sticker visible.
No close-up of factory seals, bolt torque marks, or casing seams showing untouched state; corrosion and dirt could hide prior disassembly.

risks.risk: Engine/transmission does not actually run or has internal damage (worn bearings, cracked block, bad valves)
risks.proof: A clear start-up and idle video showing the engine running smoothly with audio, or a compression test readout

risks.risk: Wrong fitment for buyer's specific Wrangler trim/year (transmission type, bellhousing match)
risks.proof: Photo of casting/part number plate matched against a parts catalog
risks.if_unproven: priced as unconfirmed fitment, same as generic used unit

risks.risk: Missing or damaged ancillary components (turbo, sensors, belts, wiring completeness)
risks.proof: Full 360-degree walk-around video showing all harness connectors and accessory mounts intact

risks.risk: Odometer/mileage claim unverifiable, could be high-mileage unit
risks.proof: Photo of dashboard odometer or OBD scan report at time of removal

risks.risk: Origin claim (Tokunbo/Belgium vs America) may be fabricated to inflate perceived quality
risks.proof: Shipping/import paperwork or customs clearance document with matching serial number
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified origin, standard scrap-yard sourcing assumed

risks.risk: Hidden corrosion or water damage not visible from given angles
risks.proof: Close-up photos of internal bores via endoscope or removed valve cover
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming surface corrosion may extend internally

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and idling with sound
Close-up photo of the casting/part number or VIN-linked ID plate
Photo of the odometer or an OBD/ECU mileage readout
Full walk-around video showing wiring harness, sensors, and accessory completeness
Any import/customs document showing country of origin matching the serial number
Close-up of casing seams/bolts to confirm it has not been previously opened
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a generic used engine-transmission assembly, so it can be priced at worst case (unverified running condition, unverified origin, and unverified fitment) pending the listed proofs.
